build_sphinx_post_transform: build a sphinx post transform that wraps myst-nb output cells in html template elements for iframe sandboxing
create_output_cells_to_iframe: create an OutputCellsToIframe sphinx post transform class that wraps glued-cell-output and cell_code_output nodes in template tags
run_output_cells_to_iframe: run the OutputCellsToIframe transform on sphinx html documents to wrap output cells in template elements
setup_sphinx_extension: setup the nb_output_cell_to_iframe sphinx extension by calling setup with a sphinx app instance to register the post transform
review_output_cells_to_iframe: review the OutputCellsToIframe class and setup function that wrap notebook output cells in html templates for iframe rendering
